changelog:
- Initial release of comprehensive PDF processing toolkit.
- Supports text and table extraction, PDF creation, merging, splitting, and handling forms.
- Includes Python and command-line recipes for common operations.
- Quick start guides and advanced usage references provided for popular libraries.
- Documentation covers both Python libraries (pypdf, pdfplumber, reportlab) and command-line tools (qpdf, pdftk, pdftotext).
